extract: Fadi Farra is a Lebanese-French scientist, author, and the founder of Whiteshield Partners. Farra's work focuses on industrial policies, innovation, microeconomics, and private sector development. Previously, he served as a head of unit at the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) in Paris, and worked as a strategy consultant with firms such as the Boston Consulting Group and AT Kearney.
title: Fadi Farra
